4659-5034-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4659-5034-5660-6769.description:
Cast Sol Ring by paying its mana cost.
When Sol Ring enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sol Ring, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Sol Ring from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

5078-5243-7295-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1879-5078-6918-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2033-3249-5075--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2033-3249-5075--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Ogre Slumlord triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

4247-4364-7917.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
4247-4364-7917.description:
Declare Aurelia and Seluma as attackers. Aurelia triggers, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Aurelia.
Deal combat damage using Seluma. Seluma triggers, returning Aurelia from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3967-6972-7936.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Dominion Saboteur that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3967-6972-7936.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dominion Saboteur.
When Dominion Saboteur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it. As it enters, choose to have it copy a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it, so Dominion Saboteur will also enter with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2646-5641-6854.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Host of the Hereafter triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

348-1152-4867-4976-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
348-1152-4867-4976-7548.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Cormela from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Activate Priest of the Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Cormela and any creature not part of the combo.
When Cormela dies, it and Open the Graves triggers.
Resolve the Cormela trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Open the Graves trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

864-2103-5144.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Eternal Witness and exiling Ephemerate.
When Eternal Witness enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

206-465-3742-4251-5929.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

280-1308-1558-2638-4231.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
280-1308-1558-2638-4231.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Anointed Procession.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

5256-5687-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
5256-5687-7084.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Skittering Precursor and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.
5256-5687-7084.notes: You can instead sacrifice the creature tokens to their own abilities instead of sacrificing them to Altar of Dementia.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2511-6972-7230.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost 2 or more life this turn.
2511-6972-7230.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Cryptborn Horror.
When Cryptborn Horror dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

465-2921-5987.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 3.

874-1170-1329-4927.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-1170-1329-4927.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Delif's Cone from your graveyard.
Cast Delif's Cone by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

147-313-2511.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-313-2511.description:
Cast Corpse Dance by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Corpse Dance.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Corpse Dance, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Corpse Dance copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

338-763-4929.description:
Activate Juju Bubble by paying {2}, causing you to gain 1 life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.

2105-2511-6591--85.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-2511-6591--85.description:
Declare Squall and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Combat Celebrant.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Squall, triggering Squall's second ability, returning Combat Celebrant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

798-1741-5337-6022.notablePrerequisites:
You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
Either Quickling or Faerie Impostor must be in your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
798-1741-5337-6022.description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Cast Cloud of Faeries by paying {1}{U}.
Archmage of Echoes triggers, copying Cloud of Faeries.
Resolve the copy of the Cloud of Faeries spell, creating a token copy of it.
When the Cloud of Faeries token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to two lands.
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Resolve the original Cloud of Faeries spell.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to two lands.
Cast either Quickling or Faerie Impostor from your hand by paying its mana cost.
Archmage of Echoes triggers, copying the Quickling or Faerie Impostor spell.
Resolve the copy of the Quickling or Faerie Impostor spell, creating a token copy of it.
When the Quickling or Faerie Impostor token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Quickling or Faerie Impostor from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the original Quickling or Faerie Impostor spell.
When Quickling or Faerie Impostor enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cloud of Faeries from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

950-1323-3143-4762.notablePrerequisites:
Experiment Kraj and Xavier Sal do not have summoning sickness.
Devoted Druid and Fatestitcher each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
You control at least one creature token.
950-1323-3143-4762.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a -1/-1 counter from Experiment Kraj, creating a copy of any creature token you control.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Fatestitcher's ability by tapping it, untapping Xavier Sal.
Repeat.

864-2034-2281-4191.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Eternal Witness.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding {C}{C}.
When Eternal Witness dies, Saffi triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Saffi by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Repeat.

2034-2700-3374.description:
Activate Antler Skulkin by paying {2}, giving Arcbound Shikari persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Arcbound Shikari, adding {C}{C}.
When Arcbound Shikari dies, its modular and persist abilities trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting all +1/+1 counters on Arcbound Shikari onto another artifact creature you control.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Shikari from your graveyard to the battlefield with one +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
When Arcbound Shikari enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other artifact creature you control.
Repeat.

877-3184-4645-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing The First Sliver, targeting any player.
Yomiji triggers, returning The First Sliver from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia trigger, causing the targeted player to mill eight cards.
Cast The First Sliver for {0}.
Resolve the First Sliver's cascade ability.
The First Sliver enters the battlefield.
Repeat.
